title: Block: Related links

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: heading
fields.instructions: Section heading (h2); empty = «Verwandte Leistungen», as on the production hubs. Two of these blocks on one page need different headings (they name their link lists).

fields.label: Links
fields.name: links
fields.instructions: Up to six pages, posts or products, in this order. Unpublished ones and the page itself are skipped; without a link the block shows nothing.

fields.label: Show excerpt
fields.name: show_excerpt
fields.instructions: A line of at most 120 characters under each title: the manual excerpt, else the start of the text. The production hub boxes show titles only.

description: Fields for the related links block (blocks/lists/related-links.php).
